description: Entities drafted from fixture signals (work items, a milestone, a project) are graded against the describe skill's rubric by a model other than the writer, majority of three votes, recorded and replayed offline, and checked by the deterministic description check (HITLD-75). Every seeded poor description is caught, on the criteria it was seeded to fail; the deterministic check alone catches all but the one whose only fault is an unbounded scope; no good control is flagged.
